term: andar la seca y la meca

1.consolidated_definition: Ver andar la seca y la meca y la tuntuneca .
1.en_consolidated_definition: To see the dry land and the Meca (a type of rural area in Puerto Rico) and the Tuntuneca (a type of rural or countryside area).

reference_definitions: Ver andar la seca y la meca y la tuntuneca .
